propositions: The reconciler's committed .bridge_state cache comprises 92% (~950 MiB) of the 1.04 GiB tickets branch, dominated by non-functional bookkeeping fields baseline_advanced_at and last_get_pass that are written but never read.

Scattered edits across the sorted 18 MB bindings.json file defeat git delta compression, resulting in 12.79 KB marginal cost per version today vs 1.74 KB after removing the timestamp and moving rotation bookkeeping.

The reconciler runs on ephemeral runners so .bridge_state must remain committed to git, but its content and churn (not location) drive costs; a multi-phase refactor deletes baseline_advanced_at, moves last_get_pass to a sidecar file, and normalizes baseline text fields.

A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/filter/fast-import reduces the existing branch from 1.17 GiB to 98 MiB (8.4%) while preserving all 49,888 commits, with a fail-closed epoch guard preventing stale-clone merges during and after the rewrite.

The rollout and reclaim are gated by descendant workflow execution proofs, live epoch-refusal testing on both review-bot and host runtimes, an off-repo backup bundle, and operator-attested quiescence confirmation including zero active sessions and stopped rebar-mcp servers.
